title: Nourishing Slovakian Berries Toast
description: A yeasty and juicy Slovakian dish featuring frozen mixed berries and double-rise-bread, perfect for a romantic lacto-vegetarian breakfast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the double-rise-bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the thawed frozen mixed berries, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract.
Spread one tablespoon of unsalted butter onto each toasted bread slice.
Top each bread slice with a spoonful of the berry mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the plain yogurt and honey until well combined.
Spoon the yogurt mixture over the berry topping on each bread slice.
Sprinkle a pinch of salt over the top of each slice.
Serve the Nourishing Slovakian Berries Toast warm and enjoy.
